data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'diá genēmai', meaning 'I am born from heaven'. Diogenia is a name associated with divine guidance and heavenly origins in Christian tradition. The name Diogenia carries the meaning “Heavenly guidance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Diogenia usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly guidance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diogenia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Diogenia holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the belief that every person is born of divine origin and has a unique purpose. It is a reminder of God's love and care for each individual, and the belief that God is present in every aspect of life. The name Diogenia can serve as a source of inspiration and strength, reminding us that we are not alone in our journey and that God is always with us, guiding and supporting us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Diogenia is a Christian name inspired by Diogenes the Cynic, an ancient Greek philosopher known for his simplicity and self-sufficiency. This name symbolizes a deep commitment to a humble, ascetic lifestyle rooted in spiritual discipline and detachment from worldly possessions. It is a reminder to live in imitation of Christ, embracing the virtues of poverty, simplicity, and inner peace, in service to God and neighbor.
